metadata.description: Claude Code mods built from real usage data: house-style enforcement and guardrails for people who ship fast.

plugins.name: aplos-no-em-dash
plugins.description: Keeps em dashes out of files, commits, PRs, outbound messages and Claude's own replies.

plugins.name: aplos-build-guard
plugins.description: Asks per item before deleting build output, binaries, git repos or project folders. Caches pass.

plugins.name: secret-redactor
plugins.description: Redacts keys, tokens and JWTs from tool output before Claude reads them. Vendored from claude-code-templates (MIT).
